<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="31" y="34" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="322" y1="29" x2="322" y2="34" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="27" x2="326" y2="34" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="25" x2="330" y2="34" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="23" x2="334" y2="34" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M344 29 Q350 23 356 29 M347 32 Q350 29 353 32" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="34" r="1.3" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="363" y="24" width="19" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="26" width="14" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="382" y="27.5" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <text x="16" y="86" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="26.8" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Communities</text>
    <circle cx="316" cy="79" r="15" fill="#0A0A0A08"/>
    <line x1="310" y1="79" x2="322" y2="79" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="316" y1="73" x2="316" y2="85" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="75" r="5.5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="354" y1="79" x2="359" y2="84" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="376" y1="72" x2="376" y2="73" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="376" y1="78" x2="376" y2="79" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="376" y1="84" x2="376" y2="85" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <line x1="16" y1="105" x2="374" y2="105" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Communities illustration shadow -->
  <rect x="75" y="142" width="240" height="226" rx="32" fill="#0000000F" opacity="0.45"/>
  <rect x="75" y="140" width="240" height="226" rx="32" fill="#F5F2EB"/>

  <!-- Illustration connecting lines -->
  <g stroke="#1DAB61" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.8">
    <line x1="195" y1="238" x2="137" y2="193"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="238" x2="253" y2="193"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="238" x2="137" y2="288"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="238" x2="253" y2="288"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Outer community circles -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="133" cy="188" r="30" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#1DAB61" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="253" cy="188" r="30" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#1DAB61" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="133" cy="294" r="30" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#1DAB61" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="253" cy="294" r="30" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#1DAB61" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- People in circles -->
  <g fill="#1DAB61">
    <circle cx="133" cy="181" r="8"/>
    <ellipse cx="133" cy="198" rx="14" ry="8"/>
    <circle cx="253" cy="181" r="8"/>
    <ellipse cx="253" cy="198" rx="14" ry="8"/>
    <circle cx="133" cy="287" r="8"/>
    <ellipse cx="133" cy="304" rx="14" ry="8"/>
    <circle cx="253" cy="287" r="8"/>
    <ellipse cx="253" cy="304" rx="14" ry="8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Central community emblem -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="238" r="47" fill="#1DAB61"/>
  <circle cx="183" cy="228" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="183" cy="246" rx="17" ry="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="207" cy="228" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="207" cy="246" rx="17" ry="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="177" y="258" width="36" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="274" r="4" fill="#F5F2EB"/>

  <!-- Introductory content -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="414" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Communities bring members</text>
    <text x="195" y="440" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">together</text>
    <text x="195" y="475" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000000">Organize related groups in one place,</text>
    <text x="195" y="498" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000000">and easily send updates to everyone.</text>
    <text x="195" y="534" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#1DAB61">See example communities</text>
    <line x1="119" y1="539" x2="271" y2="539" stroke="#1DAB61" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Primary action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="105" y="570" width="180" height="48" rx="10" fill="#0000000F"/>
    <rect x="105" y="568" width="180" height="48" rx="10" fill="#1DAB61"/>
    <line x1="137" y1="592" x2="149" y2="592" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="143" y1="586" x2="143" y2="598" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="598" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">New Community</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="650" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#959394">You can create a community for any group</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="746" width="390" height="98" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="746" x2="390" y2="746" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <!-- Chats -->
    <g transform="translate(39,762)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="25" height="18" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polygon points="5,18 5,23 11,18" fill="#FCFCFE" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="8" cy="9" r="1.2" fill="#000000"/>
      <circle cx="13" cy="9" r="1.2" fill="#000000"/>
      <circle cx="18" cy="9" r="1.2" fill="#000000"/>
      <text x="12" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Chats</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Updates -->
    <g transform="translate(116,762)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="11" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <circle cx="12" cy="11" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="12" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Updates</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Communities selected -->
    <g transform="translate(193,762)">
      <circle cx="8" cy="8" r="5" fill="#1DAB61"/>
      <circle cx="18" cy="8" r="5" fill="#1DAB61"/>
      <ellipse cx="8" cy="19" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#1DAB61"/>
      <ellipse cx="18" cy="19" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#1DAB61"/>
      <text x="13" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#1DAB61">Communities</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Calls -->
    <g transform="translate(275,762)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polyline points="8,7 11,11 9,14 12,17 15,15 18,18" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="12" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Calls</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Settings -->
    <g transform="translate(347,762)">
      <circle cx="8" cy="12" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <circle cx="8" cy="12" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="8" y1="1" x2="8" y2="5" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="8" y1="19" x2="8" y2="23" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="8" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Settings</text>
    </g>
  </g>
  <rect x="143" y="827" width="104" height="4" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
